note: Real bug case: BASE PRICE and DESTINATION & DELIVERY (right column) land on the same visual row as OPTIONAL EQUIPMENT lines (left column) -- 'RAPTOR SERIES' shares a row with 'BASE PRICE $76,775.00'.
